subject: Familiar Feathered Friend
text: One player reported that the achievement did not pop after falling from Glaive Castle a second time.

evidence.quote: Was this supposed to pop when you fall from Glaive Castle the second time? Because I'm now at the Temple of Mana and no pop.

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: Giving a fang to the boy in the city is the way to trigger this achievement.

evidence.quote: Grab a fang from the dinosaurs/reptiles in the Desert and give it to the boy in the city.

subject: dinosaurs/reptiles in the Desert
text: Fangs can be obtained from dinosaurs or reptiles in the Desert.

evidence.quote: Grab a fang from the dinosaurs/reptiles in the Desert

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: One player found another fang, went back to the guy, gave it to him, and then the achievement popped.

evidence.quote: But I found another fang and went back to the guy to give it to him and it popped.

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: One player reported no pop after the first two fangs, and it popped only after a third fang was given.

evidence.quote: Gave the fang to the guy before finding the cave, no pop. Gave another fang after beating Medusa, no pop. Then I gave another fang to him again right after, and then it pops.

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: One player reported needing to give a fang, enter the cave, then go straight back and give another fang.

evidence.quote: Seems I had to give a fang, then go into the cave, then go straight back and give another fang.

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: One player got the achievement with the first fang before ever opening the cave.

evidence.quote: Got this without a hitch with the first fang, before ever opening the cave, weirdly enough.

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: The achievement triggered on the first try for one player who gave the kid a fang before opening the cave.

evidence.quote: it triggered first try upon giving the kid a fang. I had not opened the cave yet

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: One player got the achievement by giving one fang as the first thing done in the city, before going to the mansion.

evidence.quote: I just gave the fang once and popped for me. The first thing I did in the city, actually, even before going to the mansion.

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: A player reported that giving a fang earned the achievement simply.

evidence.quote: I got fang, I give fang, I get achievement simple.

subject: To Infinity, and Beyond!
text: A later player reported the achievement was fixed a bit and could trigger right away.

evidence.quote: Seems it was fixed a bit, was able to trigger it right away

subject: Mercy
text: One player thought Amanda had to be left in her bitten state, but hitting her out of curiosity killed her.

evidence.quote: I thought I had to leave her in that state then I just hit her out of curiosity and she frikin died
